reviews_captured_by_me.text:
Very professional work and communications all along the journey.   Everyone I interacted with was friendly and helpful.
They had great rapport with the company supplying materials for other features of the kitchen and they coordinated at each step of the redecorating.
Everyone was experienced, knew what they were doing, and wanted their work to be perfect.  The man who actually cut the stone into the pieces for my kitchen, took great pride in matching up the natural patterns where piecing was required- due to the multi-angular layout of my kitchen work space/cabinets. The installer made the joints appear almost seamless!.   It is beautiful!
Totally transparent process and timely at each step; I am extremely pleased with the results of my countertops; the material is beautiful and they found the piece of stone I wanted and made certain I was happy with it before they cut/used it!  Then they made my countertops perfectly!
Overall superb and I will use their services again in the future if ever needed.  I highly recommend Raccoon !

Here is what you are going to find with Raccoon... They have the full slabs there at the shop that you can look at.  Other companies in the area have little 1 foot square blocks to look at, even Lowes and Home Depot. Others will send you up to Atlanta where they buy their slabs. (We did that too.) (Very rough neighborhood in Atlanta.)  Hundreds to look at but none of them as nice as those that Raccoon has available.  They are very nice folks and professional.  The guy that came out to our house spent 4 hours there making a template.  When it came time for the install, it was an absolute perfect fit.  We are very picky when it comes to hiring companies. Oh, and their prices beat everyone. We are so pleased with this company and highly recommend them.

Absolutely loved my experience with Raccoon Stone & Tile Works! The quality of their work is top-notch, and the attention to detail really shows in the final result. From start to finish, the team was professional, friendly, and incredibly helpful. They made the whole process easy and enjoyable, and I couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. Truly amazing people to work. My buddy actually recommended us to them and I will be coming back for any future needs. Thank you
